subject: Q3 bookings alignment: billing cutoff, PO gating, and commit review
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@acmecloud.com>, procurement@acmecloud.com
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 bookings alignment: billing cutoff, PO gating, and commit review

Hi Maya / Acme procurement team —

Quick note from the billing side to confirm timing and gating for the Q3 booking we discussed. We want to make sure the PO arrives and invoices are sequenced so recognition happens in Q3 as expected. Key deadlines below: 

- PO submission target: 2026-09-24 EOD (Acme to issue PO referencing RED-ACME-2026-Q3).
- Redwood invoice cutoff for Q3 recognition: 2026-09-30 17:00 PT. Invoices created after this will be deferred to next period unless a cutover approval is granted.
- Commit review check: internal ops/finance to complete commit signoff by 2026-09-28.

Attached is a short commit matrix showing required docs and gating criteria (redwood-commit-matrix.xlsx). Can you confirm PO ETA and whether your legal/procurement needs any redlines before the 24th? If you expect delays, let us know — we can provision a temporary hold with approvals but we need to document it for the audit trail.

Action requested from Acme:
1) Confirm PO issue date and PO number by 2026-09-20.
2) If PO will be later than 9/24, confirm approver for an exceptions window.

Ben and Lauren — looping you for awareness. Ben, please flag any red flags on the matrix and confirm whether a manual override will be feasible if Acme's PO slips one week. Lauren — please book a 30-min commit review on 9/28 if possible.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@acmecloud.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Q3 bookings alignment: billing cutoff, PO gating, and commit review

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the clear dates. Quick answers: 

- We are targeting PO issuance on 2026-09-22. I'll route the final draft through our procurement team this week.
- Legal has one small request around data processing language (we use an updated clause for 2026). I attached the PO template we will use (acme-po-template.pdf).

If the PO hits 9/22 we should be fine for your 9/24 target. If anything shifts, I will escalate to our procurement lead. Will confirm PO number by 9/20 end of day.

— Maya
Sr. Program Manager, Cloud Partnerships
Acme Cloud
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@acmecloud.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 bookings alignment: billing cutoff, PO gating, and commit review

Jordan / team — thanks for the heads-up. I reviewed the commit matrix and one operational note: if Acme provides the PO but has a different billing address than the contact on the SOW, we need PO + billing contact + remittance instructions before we can finalize the invoice by 9/30. That usually adds 24–48 hours.

If Acme's PO comes on 9/22 with all fields correct we can hit your 9/30 recognition target. If they miss 9/24, we can still process an invoice with a manual CFO approval to force recognition in-scope, but that must be documented and signed off by 2026-09-29 COB.

Proposed next steps (internal):
- Lauren: schedule 9/28 commit review 10:00–10:30 PT, invite Finance (Laura Bennett) and Ops (Ben).
- Jordan: collect PO ETA confirmation from Acme by 9/20.
- Laura: please prepare the exception approval template in case we need forced recognition.

Ben
Director, Revenue Ops
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 bookings alignment: billing cutoff, PO gating, and commit review

All — calendar invite sent for 2026-09-28 10:00 PT (30m) titled "RED-ACME Q3 commit review — billing & PO gating." Agenda attached in the invite: quick checklist review, PO verification, and signoff path for any exception.

Laura, attaching a one-page approval template in the invite notes; Ben, please bring the commit matrix and a sample of recent manual approvals for precedent. Maya — thanks for the PO timeline; please upload the issued PO to the HubSpot record when available and reply-all with the PO number so Laura can pre-populate the invoice.

If anyone needs an earlier sync, ping me and I'll move things.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
